subject: planner: add check for skew risk ratio within a bucket (#62358)
summary: Reviewed the only change in `Histogram.BetweenRowCount` (`pkg/statistics/histogram.go`): it gates the skew-ratio adjustment on `lessCountA != lessCountB` instead of `len(hg.Buckets)!=0`, preventing skew-based inflation when the estimated range is empty (e.g., both bounds out of histogram range or both falling in a gap). No Blocker/High correctness, semantic, consistency, concurrency, or session/visibility issues found in the touched statistics logic.
